skill.name: resume-claim-guard
skill.description: Draft targeted resumes from candidate-confirmed facts, identify unsupported claims, compare resume versions, and rehearse evidence-based interview answers.
skill.summary: Build a resume you can explain using confirmed experience and clear evidence.
skill.author: korey2028-prog

security_audit.summary: All 56 static findings are false positives: documentation links, user-directed installation paths, Markdown labels, and readable Chinese text. No evidence found of malicious prompt injection, credential access, unauthorized command execution, or data exfiltration in the reviewed material. The workflow requires candidate confirmation and prohibits automated applications and silent resume overwrites.

体检是写简历的最后一关,也可以单独对已有简历使用。证据状态和两条轴的定义见 [../SKILL.md](../SKILL.md)。
问完一轮就整理一次,用 [../templates/facts.md](../templates/facts.md) 的格式:
按 [../templates/facts.md](../templates/facts.md)。标明“待候选人确认”,确认后改为“YYYY-MM-DD 候选人确认”。
问完整理成带编号和日期的事实底稿(`F-01`、`F-02`......),**先给用户确认,再往下走**。问法和底稿格式见 [references/intake-questions.md](refe
把 JD 每条要求对上事实编号,状态只用五种:`已匹配`、`表达缺口`(做过但简历没写好)、`证据不足`(可能做过但缺来源)、`真实缺口`(没做过)、`待确认`。真实缺口如实列出,写进“面试时怎么诚实
逐句体检:每条主张标五种证据状态之一,查动词是否越级、数字是否有来源、是否把团队或 AI 的成果写成个人的。定向模式体检两样东西:新写的定向简历(应当全部是 `confirmed` 或 `suppor
| `confirmed` | 候选人在本次确认,或底稿有带日期的“本人确认/更正”条目写明这个值 | 按动词上限使用 |
| `supported` | 底稿能支撑,但候选人尚未确认,或边界、口径仍需说明 | 保守表达,确认前不升级 |
| `needs-source` | 简历暗示存在,底稿里没有来源 | 不写成确定事实 |
| `inference` | 审计者或模型的推断 | 只内部用,不进对外文本 |
| `rejected` | 与底稿冲突,或候选人明确不用 | 删除或改写后重审 |
底稿没提到写 `needs-source`;底稿说的是另一回事(写“上线”而事实是“原型”)写 `rejected`。同时符合多种时取最严:`rejected` > `needs-source` >
- **个人角色**:`参与/协助 → 负责(某一部分) → 主导(对整体方向和结果负责)`。团队成果写成个人、“共同”写成“独立”都算越级。
- **交付阶段**:`计划/建议 → 原型/演示 → 上线/落地(有真实用户) → 有结果数据`。AI 生成内容、原型、计划和估算,不能写成已上线、已验证或已有结果。
内部编号(`F-01`、`C-07`)只能出现在审计表和源文件注释里;对外简历、求职信和聊天文本不得出现。

content.value_statement: AI resume rewrites can introduce unsupported numbers, inflated responsibilities, and skills you have not used. This skill confirms your experience before drafting and prepares honest interview answers.
actual_capabilities: Break job descriptions into eligibility conditions, core responsibilities, capability requirements, and preferred qualifications.
Ask focused questions about personal contributions, delivery stages, dates, and metric sources before recording candidate-confirmed facts.
Match job requirements to evidence and draft targeted resumes without inventing experience.
Classify resume claims into five evidence states and flag inflated verbs, unsupported numbers, and incorrect attribution.
Compare resume versions for conflicting roles, metrics, dates, and previously submitted claims.
Prepare interview follow-up questions, factual answer points, prohibited overclaims, and honest responses to experience gaps.
limitations: Relies on candidate answers and supplied evidence; it cannot independently verify employment history or guarantee factual accuracy.
Does not search for jobs, access recruitment accounts, submit applications, or send messages.
Does not predict hiring outcomes, provide numerical match scores, or automatically generate PDFs.
Document extraction depends on the host tool; PDF review cannot verify source comments, alt text, or hidden layers.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first targeted application
use_cases.description: Turn student projects and campus activities into a targeted resume while separating personal contributions from team results.

use_cases.title: Check an AI rewrite
use_cases.description: Compare an original resume with an AI rewrite to identify invented skills, unsupported metrics, and exaggerated responsibilities.

use_cases.title: Reconcile versions before interviews
use_cases.description: Review inconsistent application versions and rehearse factual explanations for claims already sent to employers.

prompt_templates.title: Review one resume
prompt_templates.prompt: Use resume-claim-guard to review this resume: [resume text]. Ask about one experience at a time before assessing unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start with an existing resume.

prompt_templates.title: Draft for a specific role
prompt_templates.prompt: Use resume-claim-guard for this job: [job description]. My current resume is [resume]. Ask questions, confirm my facts, then draft a targeted version.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: follow the full job-to-interview workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an AI rewrite
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [original resume] with [AI rewrite] using resume-claim-guard. Check added verbs, skills, numbers, and results against [facts]. Ask me to confirm unresolved claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: identify unsupported changes before using a rewrite.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile submitted versions
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [resume A], [resume B], and [dated facts] for [job description]. Version A was submitted. Reconcile contradictions, list unresolved evidence, and rehearse honest corrections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage conflicting versions and interview explanations.

output_examples.input: A resume says the candidate launched an application serving 120 users. The candidate confirms an unpublished prototype tested with 120 registration records.
output: Claim status: rejected. The prototype was not launched, and records are not users.
Suggested wording: Created a registration prototype with AI-generated code; wrote requirements and tested imports using 120 historical registration records.
Confirmation needed: Verify the proposed wording and personal contribution before generating a public version.

output_examples.input: An earlier submitted resume claims SQL proficiency. The candidate confirms only Excel pivot-table experience.
output: Experience gap: SQL has not been used. Remove the SQL claim from the revised resume.
Interview question: Your earlier resume listed SQL. What have you used it for?
Answer point: That wording was inaccurate. My actual experience is frequency analysis using Excel pivot tables.

output_examples.input: A job requires collecting user feedback. The candidate confirms preparing a monthly summary of reader comments and questionnaire responses.
output: Requirement status: matched. Confirmed monthly feedback summaries support this responsibility.
Draft wording: Compiled reader comments and questionnaire feedback into a monthly summary for the editorial team.
Interview follow-up: What did the summary contain, and how did you collect the feedback?

best_practices: Remove phone numbers, identity numbers, home addresses, and confidential employer information before sharing documents.
Provide dated metric sources and distinguish personal work, team contributions, AI assistance, prototypes, and deployed results.
Confirm the fact ledger and final wording; identify submitted versions so interview preparation can address earlier inaccuracies.
anti_patterns: Treating job requirements or an AI rewrite as evidence that you performed the work.
Turning team results, prototype tests, or registration records into personal achievements, production deployments, or user counts.
Publishing a draft before confirmation or sending internal fact identifiers and source annotations to employers.

faq.question: Do I need a job description?
faq.answer: No. You can review one resume, compare an AI rewrite, audit against existing facts, or rehearse interviews without a job description.

faq.question: How does the skill verify my experience?
faq.answer: It asks focused questions and maps claims to supplied facts and sources. Your confirmation remains necessary; it does not conduct independent background checks.

faq.question: Can it review PDFs?
faq.answer: If the host tool extracts the text, yes. PDF review cannot verify internal comments, alt text, or hidden layers.

faq.question: Will it submit applications or contact employers?
faq.answer: No. It drafts and reviews content but does not access recruitment sites, send messages, or confirm submissions.

faq.question: Does it calculate my hiring chances?
faq.answer: No. It gives qualitative application recommendations with reasons, not hiring probabilities, pass rates, or numerical match scores.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can use the skill. A separate copyable prompt supports web chat tools, with reduced workflow detail.
